newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits market closed for May Day.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits market closed for May Day.

text.p: The Asian dollar deposit rates market was closed on Thursday for the May Day holiday. It will reopen on Friday.
On Wednesday, in day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent but Thursday/Friday eased 1/16 point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
Week-fixed was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent and three-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent. Nine-months eased 1/16 point to 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent and twelve-months eased 1/8 point to 6-5/16 6-3/16 percent.
